title: NVIDIA open 'Ising' neural decoder family: 347.7x LER suppression on d=31 color codes
summary: Open-source 17-layer 3D-CNN pre-decoder (2.9M params) cuts triangular color-code logical error rate 347.7x at 0.3% circuit-level noise, 7.3x faster than Chromobius; targets real-time lattice surgery for utility-scale FTQC. NOTE: 'Ising' is the decoder brand name, NOT fault-tolerant Ising-model simulation.

key_specs.suppression: 347.7x LER at 0.3% circuit noise, d=31 triangular color code

actionable: Shifts the decoder side of FT cost models behind HYP-2026-029's STAR-budget estimate; better decoders lower the effective logical-error floor any FT alpha=4 force experiment budgets against.
